_note: DEMO CONTENT. Every entry is marked demo:true and renders with a DEMO PROJECT tag. These describe realistic scopes of work, not work Apex has performed. Replace with real sites once the client supplies them, then set demo:false to drop the tag.

projects.title: Multi-floor corporate office
projects.brief: A single-tenant office across several floors, occupied through standard business hours with meeting rooms in near-continuous use.
projects.approach: Daytime housekeeping sized to footfall rather than floor area, with meeting-room turnaround handled between bookings. A resident technician covers lighting, plumbing and HVAC complaints so small faults never reach a vendor queue.
projects.outcome: Illustrative scope only — no performance figures are claimed.

projects.title: Gated residential community
projects.brief: A community where residents see every lapse immediately and raise it the same evening.
projects.approach: Fixed gate posts with written duty instructions, a common-area cleaning schedule published to residents, and planned upkeep of pumps, STP and lighting rather than reactive call-outs.
projects.outcome: Illustrative scope only — no performance figures are claimed.

projects.title: Manufacturing unit
projects.scope: Shopfloor housekeeping, waste handling, support manpower
projects.brief: A production environment where housekeeping is a safety control rather than a cosmetic finish.
projects.approach: Cleaning routines built around the production schedule and safety induction for every deployed operative. Waste segregation and removal on a fixed cycle, with utility areas on the same calendar as the shopfloor.
projects.outcome: Illustrative scope only — no performance figures are claimed.

projects.title: Retail store network
projects.scope: Pre-open cleaning, washroom servicing, waste removal
projects.brief: Several stores whose only free window is before opening and after close.
projects.approach: Fixed pre-open teams working to a common standard across the network, with peak-hour washroom servicing and a single coordinator across all sites instead of store-by-store escalation.
projects.outcome: Illustrative scope only — no performance figures are claimed.

projects.title: Diagnostic and day-care centre
projects.scope: Protocol-led cleaning, waste segregation, support staff
projects.brief: A clinical environment where cleaning method and its documentation carry equal weight.
projects.approach: Written protocols per area type, colour-coded equipment to prevent cross-use, segregated waste handling, and a signed record for every high-touch cleaning round.
projects.outcome: Illustrative scope only — no performance figures are claimed.

projects.title: Shared business centre
projects.brief: A multi-tenant floor where shared areas belong to everybody and therefore to nobody.
projects.approach: A single accountable supervisor for all shared space, a published cleaning frequency per zone, and a helpdesk that logs tenant requests so recurring problems become visible instead of repeating quietly.
projects.outcome: Illustrative scope only — no performance figures are claimed.
